traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Ashoka did not make Buddhism the state religion; he only gave it state patronage.
The Kalinga war is mentioned in the 13th Major Rock Edict, not the Minor Rock Edicts.
Dhamma is not identical to Buddhist Dhamma; it was a code of social ethics for a diverse empire.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Empire stretched from Hindukush to Mysore.
  • Edicts found in Brahmi, Kharosthi, Aramaic, Greek.

Personalities

  • Upagupta: The monk who converted Ashoka.
  • Moggaliputta Tissa: Convened 3rd Council.

Core Concepts

  • Dhamma Policy:
    • Non-violence (Ahimsa).
    • Tolerance (Samanvaya).
    • Social welfare (Dhamma-mahamattas).
  • Buddhist Missions:
    • Sent Mahendra and Sanghamitra to Sri Lanka.
    • Propagated teachings to Southeast Asia (Suvarnabhumi).
Edict TypeSignificance
Major Rock Edicts14 Edicts on social/ethical conduct.
Pillar EdictsFound at Topra, Meerut, Lauriya-Araraj.
